Name: Inventory Slot Lock
Author: Wooa404
Description:
Inventory Slot Lock 🔒
Keep your inventory organized and your important items right where you want them!
Inventory Slot Lock lets you lock individual inventory slots, keeping their contents in place and preventing accidental transfers to chests.

[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
[b]🔒 Lock Inventory Slots[/b]
Lock individual inventory slots to keep items in their designated positions.

[b]📦 Prevent Chest Transfers[/b]
Items in locked slots won't be transferred to chests, so you can keep your essential tools and items in your inventory.

[b]🎨 Customizable Lock Borders[/b]
Locked slots are highlighted with a visible border. Customize the border color and thickness through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to match your preferences.

[heading]⚙️ Configuration[/heading]
Customize the following settings through GMCM:
[list]
[*]Lock border color[/*]
[*]Lock border thickness[/*]
